import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import tempfile

assert subprocess.run(["jj", "--version"], capture_output=True, check=True, text=True).stdout.strip() == "jj 0.37.0"
repo = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
subprocess.run(["jj", "git", "init", str(repo)], check=True, capture_output=True)
subprocess.run(["jj", "config", "set", "--repo", "ui.log-word-wrap", "true"], cwd=repo, check=True, capture_output=True)
subprocess.run(["jj", "config", "set", "--repo", "user.name", "Majjit Test"], cwd=repo, check=True, capture_output=True)
subprocess.run(["jj", "describe", "-m", "word wrap regression fixture"], cwd=repo, check=True, capture_output=True)
fields = [
    'change_id.shortest(8), if(divergent, "/" ++ change_offset)',
    'commit_id.shortest(8)',
    'if(current_working_copy, "Y", "N")',
    'if(conflict, "Y", "N")',
    'if(empty, "Y", "N")',
    'if(root, "Y", "N")',
    'working_copies',
    'local_bookmarks.map(|b| b.name()).join(" ")',
    'tags.map(|t| t.name()).join(" ")',
    'coalesce(author.email(), "")',
    'author.timestamp().local().format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")',
    'coalesce(description.first_line(), "")',
]
marker = "_MAJJIT_"
template = "stringify(concat(" + ", ".join(f'"{marker}", {field}' for field in fields) + f', "{marker}")) ++ builtin_log_compact'
env = os.environ | {"COLUMNS": "110"}
base = ["jj", "--color", "never", "--repository", str(repo), "log", "--template", template, "--revisions", "@"]
wrapped = subprocess.run(base, env=env, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
unwrapped = subprocess.run(base[:5] + ["--config", "ui.log-word-wrap=false"] + base[5:], env=env, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
assert wrapped.splitlines()[0].count(marker) - 1 == 10
assert subprocess.run(["jj", "--repository", str(repo), "--config", "ui.log-word-wrap=false", "config", "get", "user.name"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() == "Majjit Test"
assert unwrapped.splitlines()[0].count(marker) - 1 == 12
